study type: Case-control study (sub-analysis of the BEDIP-N study)
exposure: Thyroid function (TSH, fT4, fT3, TPO antibodies)
Tertiles of fT3 and fT3-to-fT4 ratio
cohort: 199 women with GDM matched for age and BMI with 398 controls.
finding: A higher fT3-to-fT4 ratio late in pregnancy was associated with GDM, adverse pregnancy outcomes, and an adverse metabolic profile in early postpartum.
